highlight: Low time, Pro Line 21 with IFIS, TAP Blue engines, fresh Check 3.
overview:
This 2005 Premier IA has just 2,835 total hours, with both Williams FJ44-2A engines enrolled on TAP Blue (fully paid, no deferrals) and avionics on CASP. Fresh off a Check 3 inspection at 2,468 hours, shows 308 hours since HSI on both engines, and complied with the 18-year inspection in September 2023. The Collins Pro Line 21 3-tube suite includes IFIS 5000 with electric charts and XM weather, FMS-3000 v4.0, TCAS II with Change 7, and RVSM, ADS-B Out, and WAAS/LPV certification.

The six-passenger executive cabin is finished in hazelnut leather with a mid-cabin club, bronze ribbon mahogany trim, aft lavatory, and 110-volt outlets. Matterhorn white with maroon stripes, both windshields recently replaced, CAMP tracking, based in Hoquiam, WA.
